Addendum 2 — the predictability-vs-CoT-position trajectory is a REQUIRED deliverable:
  Refit the map at normalised positions through the think block against the SAME target
  (the post-think-close answer state), not only at the two endpoints:
    t = pre        last prompt token, before any think token   == Plot 7 cell A
    t in (0,1)     default grid {0.1 ... 0.9} inside the think block, matching the
                   normalised-position convention of arXiv 2603.17199
    t = end        the think-close token                        == Plot 7 cell D
  The trajectory SUBSUMES cells A and D as its endpoints. Deliverable: R2 and acc@1 vs t,
  one curve per necessity stratum, per arm, noise ceiling drawn per stratum.

  It is required because it is the direct test of the competing published claim
  (arXiv 2412.01113: probes for the final answer improve monotonically along the chain).
  A flat-and-high curve on the requires-CoT corpus would refute the serial-computation
  framing, and the design must be able to see that outcome.

  Cost: intermediate positions come from the SAME forward pass, so capture is near-free
  once traces exist. The added cost is the refit per position (9 extra ridge fits per arm
  per target) — this is the vectorizable many-cell fit case. Batch the position axis, do
  NOT loop (.claude/rules/vectorize-many-cell-fits.md).
